description: Seed rows for the HR Change Templates list (master SOP checklists, never completed themselves). The router copies these into HR Change Tasks for every new request. automation: Approval = ticked by the Approvals flow; Resolution = ticked by the Resolution flow when Status becomes 3-Resolved. blocked = stays 'Blocked - awaiting approval' until approved. dueOnEffectiveDate = task due date is the last day / effective date.

A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).title: Confirm last day and exit reason
A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).details: Capture: resignation, end of contract, or mutual separation

A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).title: Obtain resignation letter from manager → save to HR file
Acknowledge receipt to manager; send link to New Req Request form (backfill)
Forward resignation letter to relevant People leadership
Send change-in-relationship notice as PDF to employee; file copy into HR file
Add to Monday payroll board — final pay and PTO payout
Notify offboarding distro
A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).details: Triggers: Tech ticket to Methodology (access revocation) • Credentialing team deactivates in Medallion • ICS confirms whether client-issued equipment needs return • Equipment return materials sent if applicable (client included if embedded)

A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).title: Create Jira ticket → access revocation + equipment retrieval (IT)
A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).details: Paste the ticket link into the request's Jira link field

A1 — Offboarding (Voluntary).title: Terminate in Paycor — on last day only (do not enter early; date may shift)
Move HR folder to Termed (PC entity or LLC entity per applicable structure)
Send exit interview feedback to manager / People leadership
Confirm completion → post summary to HR intake channel

A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).title: Confirm last day and exit reason
A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).details: Capture: termination, reduction in force, end of contract (non-renewed), or performance-based

A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).title: Notify offboarding distro
A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).details: Triggers: Tech ticket to Methodology (access revocation — timing-sensitive, coordinate with last day) • Credentialing team deactivates in Medallion • ICS confirms whether client-issued equipment needs return • Equipment return materials sent if applicable (client included if embedded)

A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).title: Create Jira ticket → access revocation + equipment retrieval (IT)
A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).details: Paste the ticket link into the request's Jira link field

A2 — Offboarding (Involuntary).title: Generate termination letter (Word template) → send to employee with letter attached
Send change-in-relationship notice as PDF to employee; file copy into HR file
Add to Monday payroll board — final pay and PTO payout
Terminate in Paycor — on last day only (do not enter early; date may shift)
Move HR folder to Termed (PC entity or LLC entity per applicable structure)
Confirm completion → post summary to HR intake channel

B — Job / Status Change.title: Confirm new title, department, location, FT/PT/PRN status
Route approval request → manager + Regional (per approval matrix)

C — Comp Change.title: Confirm new rate, effective pay period
Route approval → manager, Regional, HR (per approval matrix)
On approval: notify payroll via email or Monday payroll board post

D — Pay / Banking Change.title: Flag for manual verification → DM CJ or Johanna
Log verification + completion to list item

E — Personal Data Change.title: Confirm field(s) changing and new value

F — Time / PTO.title: Route to manager for approval
F — Time / PTO.details: Automatic: HR Change - 3 Approvals (replaces the Slack DM step)

G — LOA.title: Confirm leave type, start date, expected return
Route to CJ for case management setup
Log to list item with return date noted
G — LOA.details: Keep 'End / expected return' current on the request - the daily digest flags returns due within 7 days

G — LOA.title: Keep item open (1-Assigned) until return confirmed
G — LOA.details: Only set 3-Resolved once the return is confirmed

H — Benefits / Life Event.title: Confirm event type and qualifying date
Route to benefits team or process in Employee Navigator

I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.title: HR approval: review against predetermined criteria
I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.details: Rate validity, hours/dates make sense, within policy. Automatic: HR Change - 3 Approvals

I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.title: Earning setup: add a single event earning in Paycor
I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.details: Rate type (hourly vs. flat day rate) drives which earning code is used

I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.title: Confirm the earning is logged against the correct pay period
I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.details: Check Pay period / Submitted after cutoff on the request

I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.title: Mark list item complete (3-Resolved) once the earning is entered
I — Fractional FTE / Extra Shift Pickup.details: Payroll is then notified automatically to verify in Paycor. They are a verifier, not a gate
